dataset.title: Experimental data
dataset.description: Data related to each of our proposed experiments. These will include the detailed protocols used for each experiment, the raw data collected from each experiment, and the experimental code used to collect those data.

distribution.title: Experimental data
distribution.description: Data will be made available upon request, after the conclusion of each of study.

metadata.description: The contents of each data file, including the experimental conditions or the analysis procedures used during generation will be documented.

dataset.title: Analysis code and results
dataset.description: The code and results for all analyses completed on experimental data.

distribution.title: Analysis code and results
distribution.description: Access will be free, but the original data collector/creator/principal investigator retains the right to use the data for analysis before making it publicly available.

metadata.description: The code needed to generate all published results will be documented clearly.

dataset.title: Simulation code
dataset.description: The proposed foundational developments will produce substantial simulation code for controller development and testing.

distribution.title: Simulation code
distribution.description: Software generated under the project will be released under the GNU Public License, and available for free download on the labs’ websites.

project.title: CPS 2015
project.description: This project aims to analyze the impact of urbanization on local biodiversity by collecting and assessing environmental data from multiple urban centers.
